content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This infrastructure breakdown is designed specifically for digital creators like musicians who need an alternative to conventional payment processors. Platforms like Gumroad charge high fees, often 10% on sales, which cuts into your profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin with only a 0.5% fee. This significant cost difference means more revenue retained from each sale, empowering you to reinvest in your music and grow your brand.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this infrastructure leverages free tools to create a seamless sales process. You can host your music on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automate delivery through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and manage orders with Supabase or Google Sheets. This setup ensures that you have complete ownership of your digital products and data, with no ongoing subscriptions or fees. The integration with NOWPayments allows for instant crypto payment verification, ensuring that transactions are secure and efficient.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for musicians and digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where traditional payment gateways are restricted or unavailable. It empowers you to sell your music without giving up control to third-party platforms. By using this infrastructure, you’re not just creating a store; you’re building a sustainable revenue stream that can withstand the volatility of traditional financial systems.
Retain more of your earnings by reducing transaction fees to 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include a hosting service (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets), and file delivery (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). Each component works in harmony to provide a seamless experience for you and your customers. The integration with NOWPayments ensures that you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, making it easy for your audience to pay in their preferred currency.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your online music store, start by selecting your hosting service and setting up a repository. Next, create the backend logic to handle orders and integrate payment processing with NOWPayments. Load your products into the order storage system and configure your file delivery method. Finally, ensure everything is tested and functioning before launching your store. For a complete step-by-step guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to get all the blueprints and templates you need.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Complete ownership of your products and data with no ongoing subscriptions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell your music and other digital products without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for a comprehensive solution. This kit includes all the necessary blueprints and templates to set up your sovereign commerce stack, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell an ebook using a sovereign digital commerce stack that incorporates NOWPayments for payment processing, avoiding reliance on traditional payment platforms. This method allows you to retain more earnings and maintain control over your sales.

The best way is to create your own online store using free infrastructure tools like GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments. This setup minimizes fees and maximizes your earnings while providing you with complete ownership of your products.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by using a sovereign commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly from your own platform. This approach avoids the high fees of Gumroad or Payhip, allowing you to keep a larger share of your profits.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than the fees charged by platforms like Gumroad. This low fee structure ensures you retain more earnings from each sale.
How does the file delivery work in this setup?
File delivery can be handled using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. When a customer makes a purchase, the system automatically delivers the digital product, ensuring a smooth and efficient experience.
